name: @quandev104/pi-style
description: A native-layout, cohesive visual style package for Pi.

scripts.package:smoke: node --input-type=module -e "const manifest = await import('./package.json', { with: { type: 'json' } }); if (manifest.default.pi.extensions[0] !== './dist/extensions/pi-style.js') throw new Error('invalid Pi extension manifest path'); const extension = await import('./dist/extensions/pi-style.js'); if (typeof extension.default !== 'function') throw new Error('built extension has no default factory'); console.log('package smoke: built extension loaded');"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run depcruise && npm run test && npm run build && npm run package:smoke
